text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Spring)— 
Standing in her way is Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe continued her strong 
performances, but the more fiercely her 
spirit burned, the greater the toll on her 
body, beginning to eat away at her like 
poison.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is it really right to let her chase after 
her "friend"...? Bound by the promise made 
with her, the Trainer could only pray for 
her safety.
